text:
alia: Quick heads-up — ran into a reproducible flake in samplekit when json_mode streams hit an auth-resume retry.
rohan: can you paste a minimal repro?
alia: steps: 1) start samplekit /generate with json_mode=true and a streaming tool that emits array items, 2) expire token mid-stream, 3) SDK refreshes and retries the tail. The stitcher naively concatenates replayed fragments and you end up with a '][' boundary, which blows up the schema validator.
pat: ugh. is this the append-without-reset issue?
claire: yep. stitcher currently does buffer += chunk; parse(buffer) on boundaries. No replay/session detection. If a prefix gets replayed you get two array boundaries next to each other.
rohan: practical remediation ideas: (A) short-term: make parser tolerant in json_mode (trim isolated leading/trailing brackets/separators before parse), (B) medium: emit stream-session-id and chunk-index headers so retries can be detected and stitcher can reset/skip, (C) long-term: use length-prefixed framing for structured streams to avoid ambiguous separators.
alia: short-term patch will help onboarding customers. we should also add a troubleshooting blurb in the samplekit README.
pat: i'll PR a defensive change in sdk-js stitcher to ignore lone '[' or ']' tokens when json_mode=true and to emit a log event when auth-refresh+retry occurs.
claire: please add a unit test that simulates a replayed prefix: initial stream sends '[
{a:1}
' then a retry replays '[
{b:2}
' — assert final assembled array equals [{a:1},{b:2}] and not two adjacent arrays.
rohan: also audit sdk-py and sdk-ts; parity bug likely.
sdk-bot: created issue #5421: samplekit stream resume after auth refresh -> fragment concat causes schema error (assignees: pat, claire)
alia: attaching QA trace, token-expiry harness, and a short video of the failing run to the issue.
pat: PR incoming with parser tolerance + retry event logs; follow-up PR will add session header and chunk-index.
claire: i'll update onboarding docs and add a short troubleshooting section about auth refresh during streaming + json_mode.
rohan: nice. once session headers land we should run a quick benchmark comparing framing vs current approach for overhead.
alia: thanks team — i'll monitor #5421 and ping if QA finds more variants.
